workarounds.symptom: Runner.run_streamed sends a model request after a parallel input guardrail has already tripped
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: skip streamed model attempts after an input guardrail trips. Target files: src/agents/run_internal/model_retry.py, src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py, tests/test_stream_input_guardrail_timing.py. This pull request fixes a case where `Runner.run_streamed` could send a model request after a parallel input guardrail had already rejected the input. The runner now checks the recorded verdict immediately before opening each model stream, including retries. Pending guardrails still allow parallel execution, and er... (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5644)

workarounds.symptom: An approved tool's guardrail results are dropped when the resumed run continues to the next turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: retain tool guardrail results after approval and resume. Target files: src/agents/run.py, src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py, tests/test_agent_runner.py. This pull request fixes the loss of tool guardrail results when an approved tool finishes and the runner calls the model again. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5643)

workarounds.symptom: Default tool error text tells the model to "try again" after a call that may already have taken effect
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: remove retry advice from the default tool error message. Target files: src/agents/tool.py, tests/mcp/test_mcp_util.py, tests/sandbox/capabilities/test_tool_input_errors.py. This pull request removes "Please try again." from the default tool error message. A tool can raise after a write succeeds, and the SDK cannot determine whether repeating the call is safe. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/5632)
